title: French Kenyan Stir Fry
description: A unique twist on traditional French cuisine, this recipe combines Kenyan spices with a French-inspired stir fry.

ingredients.name: Kenyan seasoning
ingredients.notes: Use a blend of African spices

instructions: Heat the fry oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onions and bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Kenyan tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes.
Stir in the gooey butter until melted and well combined.
Add the Kenyan seasoning and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the salty cheese until melted and well combined.
